✳ Art, powered by a hamster.Public SqueekChain data · Every 15 seconds

One wheel. Endless expression.

SqueekPulse turns SqueekChain’s real hamster wheel telemetry into generative particle art. Every reading leaves its own impression.

RPM → Motion
A faster wheel makes the particles travel faster.
Block progress → Color
Confirmed block progress shifts the palette from green through blue.
Running → Energy
The field brightens and expands when the wheel is spinning. At rest, it drifts gently.
SQK mined → Light
The amount mined adds a subtle glow to each particle.

Move your pointer over the canvas, or touch it, to stir the field. Use Space on the canvas to pause. Save image downloads the current artwork as a PNG.

Readings refresh every 15 seconds from /v1/status and /v1/economy/state. If a source fails, its last reading is marked stale. Without fresh wheel data, the canvas uses a clearly labeled ambient drift.
